title: New Boss Program
rules_text: The Boss turn this Program plays, named in the Boss's own voice.

instant_beats.title: Face the Threat
instant_beats.rules_text: The Boss turns toward the closest Hero.

instant_beats.title: Close the Distance
instant_beats.rules_text: The Boss walks up to 2 hexes toward the closest Hero, stopping once it is within reach.

incoming_beats.title: Telegraphed Breath
incoming_beats.rules_text: Deal 2 damage to every Hero in the forward cone, out to 2 hexes.
